title: Situating the social issues of image generation models in the model life cycle: a sociotechnical approach

bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of literature evaluating how gender stereotypes, such as biased occupational depictions and hypersexualized representations, manifest across the text-to-image model life cycle.
Thematic analysis of literature assessing the reproduction of racial stereotypes and biased skin-tone associations within image generation models and their training data.
Thematic analysis of literature identifying Western and American-centric biases, as well as the generation of harmful stereotypes about non-Western cultures through prompt modifications.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Thematic analysis of literature exploring how training data filtering and content moderation can lead to the erasure or pornographication of LGBTQ+ and non-cisgender identities.
Thematic analysis of literature highlighting how contextual factors and background objects in generated images reproduce stereotypes related to socioeconomic status.
